# GAP iNTERDISCIPLINARITIES

> > A peer-reviewed, open-access quarterly journal publishing interdisciplinary and transdisciplinary research under the Grand Academic Portal (GAP) network.

GAP iNTERDISCIPLINARITIES (ISSN-2581-5628) is published by GAP Research Journals and operates under Creative Commons licensing. The journal is led by Dr. Preeti Oza (St. Andrew's College, University of Mumbai) and Dr. Jasmine Gujarathi (CVM University), promoting scholarly collaboration across diverse academic disciplines.

- [GAP iNTERDISCIPLINARITIES - A GLOBAL JOURNAL OF INTERDISCIPLINARY STUDIES ( ISSN- 2581-5628)](https://gapinterdisciplinarities.org/index): Homepage for GAP iNTERDISCIPLINARITIES peer-reviewed journal (ISSN-2581-5628)
